text:
sophia: Found a tiny party hat at the tide pools and now Pearl refuses to leave it on 🐚🪩 https://i.imgur.com/pearl-partyhat.jpg :crab: :heart_eyes:
noah: omg that little shell helmet is perfect. is she wearing it unprompted or do you persuade her? :laughing:
sophia: she climbed into it herself and gave me the side-eye like I interrupted her DJ set. tried to get a video but she does a dramatic slow-pivot and then naps.
amina: iconic. mandatory office sticker? can we get a tiny crab version of the Redwood mascot? :crab::redwood:
kevin: tiny merch idea: "Pearl's Party Hat" enamel pin. 100% would buy. :moneybag::pin:
sophia: also PSA: hermit crabs love humid, shaded shells. the hat is on but she still has a proper shell underneath, we didn't replace anything. no worries. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: Reminder: pets-in-office day is next Tue 11am-3pm. Please only bring animals you've checked with People Ops and that are comfortable in crowds. :bell:
noah: noted. bringing snacks for Pearl. maybe a tiny disco ball too. :tada:
sophia: will bring. photo drop incoming later with slo-mo wiggle.
